question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Arrest
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arrest"** means to seize someone by legal authority and take them into custody. (गिरफ्तार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police had to **arrest** the suspect to prevent further crimes.
 
 
 
• **"Unbind"** means to release someone from bonds or restraints. (बाँधन खोलना)
 
 
• **Example: **The magician will **unbind** the ropes and free himself from the box.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Arrest' **is **'Unbind'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stall** (रोकना): To stop or cause to stop making progress.

 
 
• **Example:** The car engine** stalled** in the middle of the road.
 
 
 
• **Standstill** (ठहराव): A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.
 
 
• **Example: **Traffic came to a** standstill **due to the accident.
 
 
 
• **Detain** (हिरासत में लेना): To keep someone in official custody, typically for questioning about a crime.
 
 
• **Example:** The police** detained** the suspect for further questioning.
 
 

33:Tdee,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
